svg.title: Pastry Pirates — V3 · The Round Table — Ingredient crates (28)
svg.desc: Four per ingredient: three to stock an island at 3–4 players, one spare for the black market. Wheat, milk, sugar, eggs, cocoa, cinnamon, vanilla — the app's own icons, engraved on identical 14.944 mm rounded squares that sit inside a 23.35 mm board square. Every tile is the same and the backs are bare, so they can be turned face down for the bake-off. Units: mm. 23.35 mm squares, 5.9 mm material. KERF-COMPENSATED: cut lines offset 0.1375 mm away from the kept wood (kerf 0.275 mm) — cut exactly on the line. RASTER = black fill (engrave), CUT = red hairline (cut). Generated by physical-board/generate.mjs.
